title: The Midnight Builder v8 — The Departure

scenes.name: The Departure
scenes.notes: Marcus packs up his desk with quiet dignity, walks through the office floor past colleagues who avoid eye contact, and exits the building. Emotional through restraint — no crying, just the quiet weight of a man carrying his whole life in a box.

characters.name: Marcus

characters.wardrobe: charcoal business suit with loosened navy tie, white dress shirt, gold wedding ring on left hand
characters.ref_prompt: 3D Pixar-style animation character reference sheet.
